document.abstract: Increasing productivity is the most important job today. It will not be done by “speeding up.” Work simplification, using motion pictures as the main tool, helps everyone in an organization to find “the one best way.” Applications of the motion picture in such studies are described in the paper, as also a specially designed projector for exhibiting the pictures.
